result.title: Cross-User Adaptation for sEMG Gesture Recognition via Continual Learning
result.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IEEE BioCAS 2026
result.summary: Prosthetic and assistive interfaces increasingly depend on decoding hand gestures from surface electromyography (sEMG). Because the signal is shaped by person-specific factors, the recurrent neural networks (RNNs) commonly used to model these temporal streams must adapt to new wearers and new gesture classes after deployment. Continual learning (CL) enables this adaptation without retraining from scratch, yet applying it to recurrent sEMG models is not straightforward. Standard recurrent training practices can destabilize learning, and which CL strategy holds up under realistic cross-user drift is unestablished. We evaluate three representative CL strategies under domain- and class-incremental drift on NinaPro DB1, and find experience replay to outperform elastic weight consolidation (EWC) and naive fine-tuning. It reaches 83.3% final accuracy for class-incremental drift while limiting forgetting to 1.8-5.8% accuracy drop, as against 16.2-28.5% for EWC and naive training. We further show these models must be trained on shuffled, independently-windowed segments. Streaming windows in temporal order collapses the network into predicting a single dominant gesture, while a shuffled, stateless regime trains stably. Finally, hand-crafted time-domain features raise per-task accuracy by up to about 40% over raw signals, but only replay preserves that gain under class-incremental drift.

AI.brief_summary: 在 NinaPro DB1 上比较经验回放、EWC 与朴素微调三种持续学习策略对 RNN 肌电手势解码的跨用户域增量与类增量适应效果，并分析窗口采样方式与时域手工特征的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按时间顺序流式窗口使循环网络坍缩为单一预测、打乱的无状态窗口才稳定」的现象，可能与 LVR 中循环/多步 latent 状态坍缩与轨迹训练监督相关；回放保持旧能力的结论或可供核查持续适应下的推理轨迹，但领域相隔较远。
